messages.subject: Filter after unite tiles
parts:
Hello,
I tried to filter the coverage of my tiles after unite, but when I want to do the  calculateDiffMeth() I have this error:

meth <- unite(tiles, destrand = FALSE)
> meth_filter=meth[meth$coverage1> 4 & meth$coverage2>4 ,]
> myDiff <- calculateDiffMeth(meth_filter, num.cores = 2)
Erreur dans function (classes, fdef, mtable)  :
  unable to find an inherited method for function "calculateDiffMeth", for signature "data.frame"

Do you have any idea how to do it?

Thanks,

Mohamed

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: Filter after unite tiles
parts:
which version of methylKit are you using? subsetting with [ ] should produce a new methylBase object not a data frame.

here is an example:
library(methylKit)
data(methylKit)

methylBase.obj
methylBase.obj[1:10,]
